sources.excerpt: Bricks by Colombo Audio Electronics | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Colombo Audio Electronics Bricks LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE DISTORTION BOOSTER EQUALIZER Description Bricks is a double pedal designed and built with the aim of obtaining the sounds of the iconic guitarist David Gilmour. Thanks to his unique style, has given to the world some inestimable artistic value works. Visionary, eclectic, elegant and intelligible are just some of the attributes of the guitarist from Cambridge, the Bricks wants to be our tribute to this great artist. The Bricks wants to devote itself to the distortion/overdrive sector, objectively recreating as many solutions as possible adopted by Gilmour over the years. The circuits are all original, although strongly inspired by the reference units used by the English guitarist.
